mapper.select: select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where type = #{type} and status = 'active' and effective_at <= now() limit 1
select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where status = 'active' and effective_at <= now() order by type
select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where type = #{type} and status = 'draft' order by updated_at desc limit 1

select id, document_id, locale, title, sections, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_document_contents where document_id = #{documentId} order by case when locale = 'zh' then 0 else 1 end, locale limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_legal_documents set version = #{version}, status = #{status}, effective_at = #{effectiveAt}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_legal_documents set status = 'archived', updated_at = now() where type = #{type} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_legal_document_contents ( id, document_id, locale, title, sections, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{documentId}, #{locale}, #{title}, #{sections}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update title = values(title), sections = values(sections), updated_at = now()

insert into cm_user_agreement_acceptances (id, user_id, document_type, document_version, accepted_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{documentType}, #{documentVersion}, #{acceptedAt}) on duplicate key update accepted_at = case when document_version <> values(document_version) then values(accepted_at) else accepted_at end, document_version = values(document_version)
